subject: sentences
title: Because and so
about: Because tells why something happened (I wore a coat because it was cold) and so tells what happened next (it was cold, so I wore a coat), with a few and, but and or cards mixed in. These are the five conjunctions DPI names for NC's K-1 grammar continuum (L.1.1) and L.1.6, and the level follows And, but, or at the end of the year.
tip: Ask which part is the reason: because sits right before the reason, and so sits right before what happened next.

cards.q: I wore a coat ___ it was cold.
cards.sayQ: I wore a coat, blank, it was cold. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Because tells why. Why did I wear a coat? Because it was cold.

cards.q: The pup was wet ___ it ran in the rain.
cards.sayQ: The pup was wet, blank, it ran in the rain. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Because tells why. Why was the pup wet? Because it ran in the rain.

cards.q: Ben ran fast ___ he was late.
cards.sayQ: Ben ran fast, blank, he was late. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Because tells why. Why did Ben run fast? Because he was late.

cards.q: We used an umbrella ___ it was raining.
cards.sayQ: We used an umbrella, blank, it was raining. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Because tells why. The rain is the reason for the umbrella.

cards.q: Max ate lunch ___ he was hungry.
cards.sayQ: Max ate lunch, blank, he was hungry. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Because tells why. Being hungry is the reason he ate.

cards.q: The ice melted ___ the sun was hot.
cards.sayQ: The ice melted, blank, the sun was hot. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Because tells why. The hot sun is the reason the ice melted.

cards.sayQ: It rained, blank, we stayed in. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: So tells what happened next. It rained, and then what? We stayed in.

cards.q: Sam was hungry, ___ he ate a snack.
cards.sayQ: Sam was hungry, blank, he ate a snack. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: So tells what happened next. First he was hungry, then he ate.

cards.q: The bus was late, ___ we walked.
cards.sayQ: The bus was late, blank, we walked. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: So tells what happened next. The bus was late, and then what? We walked.

cards.q: Zoe was cold, ___ she got a blanket.
cards.sayQ: Zoe was cold, blank, she got a blanket. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: So tells what happened next. First she was cold, then she got a blanket.

cards.q: It was hot, ___ we went to the pool.
cards.sayQ: It was hot, blank, we went to the pool. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: So tells what happened next. It was hot, and then what? We went to the pool.

cards.q: Ben lost his hat, ___ he got a new one.
cards.sayQ: Ben lost his hat, blank, he got a new one. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: So tells what happened next. First he lost his hat, then he got a new one.

cards.q: Do you want to hop ___ skip?
cards.sayQ: Do you want to hop, blank, skip? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Or gives a choice: hop or skip.

cards.q: Mia likes jam, ___ Ben does not.
cards.sayQ: Mia likes jam, blank, Ben does not. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: But tells a change or a surprise. Mia likes it, Ben does not.

cards.q: Max ___ Ava are at the zoo.
cards.sayQ: Max, blank, Ava are at the zoo. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: And joins two people who go together.

cards.q: The box is big, ___ it is light.
cards.sayQ: The box is big, blank, it is light. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: But tells a surprise. You might think a big box is heavy, but this one is light.
